newsitem.title: USA: Securacom Inc IPO gets new terms.
newsitem.headline: Securacom Inc IPO gets new terms.

text.p: Terms were modified for the planned initial public offering of Securacom Inc, lead underwriter Hanifen Imhoff Inc said on Monday.
A total of 1.4 million shares will be offered for a target price of $7 each, down from an earlier estimate of two million shares to price for $8.50 to $10.50 each.
The two million shares were comprised of the company's sale of 1.7 million shares and current shareholders' sale of 300,000 shares.
The composition of the current offer for 1.4 million shares consists of 1.1 million shares on sale by the company and 300,000 shares by current shareholders.

In May the company filed for an initial target price $10 per share but later refiled for an estimated price range of $8.50 to $10.50 each. The shares are expected to trade under the symbol "SECU" on the Nasdaq National Market.
Securacom, expected to trade on Tuesday, is a consulting engineering company.
